newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon's Solidere up on higher turnover.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon's Solidere up on higher turnover.

text.p: Solidere shares rose on higher turnover on Friday. A shares rose to $113.875 from $111.375 and B shares rose also to $116.375 from $115.
It was the first time the shares had risen in the five days of trading this week. Turnover was 11,180 shares up from Thursday's 10,634 and value was $1,275,247.625 from $1,202,675.25.

Also traded were 5,000 Ciments Libanais shares at $1.2812, down from $1.3125 on November 5 when 1,000 were traded, and 100 shares of piping maker Eternit at $1.5625, up from $1.50 on Wednesday when 10,000 shares changed hands.
There was no trade for the fifth successive week in the two other companies listed on the Beirut Stock Exchange: Ciments Blancs and Uniceramic.
The LISPI stock index rose 0.73 percent to 81.98 and the BLOM stock index also rose 0.95 percent to 974.09.
